verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses, laying out the next steps: 📜
“Here’s the play when somebody’s serious skin disease clears up: they’ve got to come see the priest. 🩺
The priest must head outside the camp and check them out. If the disease has really healed, ✅
the priest must tell them to bring two live, clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop for the cleansing. 🐦
Then the priest must have one bird killed in a clay pot over fresh running water. 💧
He must grab the live bird, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop, then dip the whole set—including the bird—in the blood from the bird killed over running water. 🐦
He must sprinkle the person being cleansed seven times, call them clean, then let that live bird fly off into the open country. 🕊️
“The person must wash their clothes, shave off all their hair, and bathe in water; then they’re clean. They can come back into camp, but their own tent is off-limits for seven days. 🧼
On day seven, it’s the full shave: head, beard, eyebrows, every bit. They must wash their clothes and bathe their whole body in water; then they’re clean. ✂️
“On day eight, they must bring two male lambs with no defects, one year-old ewe lamb with no defect, three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, and one log of oil. 🐑
The priest handling the cleansing must bring the person and all those offerings before Yahweh at the Meeting Tent entrance. 🏕️
“The priest must take one male lamb and the log of oil, present them as a guilt offering, and lift them up before Yahweh as a special offering. 🙌
He must kill the lamb where the sin and burnt offerings are killed, in the holy place. The guilt offering belongs to the priest just like the sin offering; it’s most holy. 🐑
The priest must take some guilt-offering blood and put it on the person’s right earlobe, right thumb, and big toe on the right foot. 🩸
“Then the priest must pour some of that log of oil into his own left palm. 🫗
He must dip a finger from his right hand into the oil in his left palm and flick some of it seven times before Yahweh. 💧
The priest must dab some oil still in his hand on the person’s right earlobe, right thumb, and big toe—right over that guilt-offering blood. 🩸
He must put whatever oil remains in his hand on the person’s head and make atonement for them before Yahweh. 🫗
“The priest must offer the sin offering and make atonement for the person being cleansed from their uncleanness. After that, he must kill the burnt offering. 🔥
Then the priest must offer the burnt offering and grain offering on the altar. Atonement is made for the person, and they’re clean—good to go. ✅

“If the person is poor and can’t afford all that, they must bring one male lamb as a guilt offering, waved for their atonement; one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering; and one log of oil. 🐑
They must also bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons—whatever they can afford. One is for the sin offering and the other for the burnt offering. 🕊️
“On day eight of their cleansing, they must bring these to the priest at the entrance to the Meeting Tent, before Yahweh. 🏕️
The priest must take the guilt-offering lamb and the log of oil, then wave them before Yahweh as a special offering. 🙌
He must kill the guilt-offering lamb, take some of its blood, and put it on the person’s right earlobe, right thumb, and big toe on the right foot. 🩸
“The priest must pour some of the oil into his own left palm, 🫗
then use a finger from his right hand to flick some oil from his left palm seven times before Yahweh. 💧
The priest must put some oil from his hand on the person’s right earlobe, right thumb, and big toe, right where the guilt-offering blood went. 🩸
He must put the rest of the oil from his hand on the person’s head, making atonement for them before Yahweh. 🫗
“Then the priest must offer whichever turtledove or young pigeon the person could afford, 🕊️
one bird as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, together with the grain offering. The priest must make atonement for the person being cleansed before Yahweh.” 🔥
That’s the rule for anyone with this skin disease who can’t afford the full offering list for their cleansing. 📜
Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron: 📜
“When you enter Canaan, the land I’m handing over to you, a spreading mildew might show up in one of your houses. 🏠
Then the owner must go tell the priest, ‘There’s some kind of outbreak in my house, I think.’ 🦠
“Before the priest goes in to inspect it, he must have the house cleared out, so nothing inside gets declared unclean. Then he can go check the place. 📦
He must inspect the outbreak. If the walls have greenish or reddish sunken streaks that look deeper than the surface, 🔍
the priest must step outside to the doorway and lock the place down for seven days. 🚪
“On day seven, the priest must pull back up and check. If the mildew has spread across the walls, 🔍
he must order the affected stones pulled out and dumped in an unclean place outside the city. 🧱
The inside walls of the whole house must be scraped clean; that scraped plaster gets dumped in an unclean place outside the city too. 🧹
Then they must set fresh stones where the old ones were and plaster the house again. 🧱
“But if the outbreak comes back after the stones were removed, the house scraped, and the walls replastered, 🦠
the priest must come inspect it. If the mildew has spread, it’s destructive mildew in the house; the house is unclean. ⚠️
The whole house must come down—stones, timber, all that plaster—and get hauled outside the city to an unclean place. 🏚️
“Anyone who goes into the house while it’s shut up is unclean until evening. 🚪
Anyone who crashes there or eats in that house must wash their clothes. 🧼
“But if the priest checks it and the mildew hasn’t spread after the house was plastered again, he must declare the house clean—the outbreak has cleared. ✅
To cleanse the house, he must take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop. 🐦
He must kill one bird in a clay pot over fresh running water. 💧
He must take the cedar wood, hyssop, scarlet yarn, and living bird, dip them in the dead bird’s blood and the running water, then sprinkle the house seven times. 🏠
That’s how he cleanses the house: with the bird’s blood, running water, live bird, cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet yarn. 🧹
Then he must release the living bird outside the city into the open country. That’s how he makes atonement for the house, and it’s clean.” 🕊️
“That’s the full rulebook for any serious skin disease or itching condition, 🩺
and for mildew in clothing or in a house, 🧥
and for a swelling, scab, or bright spot—🔍
so people know what’s unclean and what’s clean. That’s the skin-disease rule, no confusion.” 📜
